customer.list.searchHint: The beginning of the customer's email. Upper and lower case do not matter and spaces around the text are ignored. At most {max} characters. Names are not searched.
customer.list.searchTooLong: The search is too long for an email.
customer.list.caption: Customers, ordered by email
customer.list.pastEnd: This page is past the end of the list.
customer.list.emptyBody: Customers appear here after they register in the shop.
customer.list.noMatchBody: No customer's email starts with this text. Check it, or clear the search.
customer.detail.title: Customer
customer.detail.name: Name
customer.detail.lockedAlert: Five failed sign-ins lock an account for 15 minutes, and sign-in is refused while the lock is in force. The lock ends by itself, or an admin who may manage customers can clear it. The API does not tell when this lock ends.
customer.action.deactivateHint: Ends all sessions of this customer at once and refuses their sign-in until the account is activated again. Asks for confirmation first.
customer.action.activateHint: Lets the customer sign in again.
customer.action.unlockHint: Clears the failed sign-in counter and the lock, so the customer can try to sign in again. Their sessions are not touched.
customer.deactivate.title: Deactivate this customer?
customer.deactivate.description: All sessions of this customer end at once, so every browser they are signed in with stops working, and sign-in is refused while the account is deactivated. The account and its orders are kept. You can activate the account again.
customer.notice.done.deactivate: The customer is deactivated: all their sessions ended and sign-in is refused. The details are read again below.
customer.notice.done.activate: The customer is active again and can sign in. The details are read again below.
customer.notice.done.unlock: The lock is cleared. The customer can try to sign in again. The details are read again below.
customer.notice.unknownReading: The answer did not arrive. The request was sent once and is not repeated. Reading the customer again to see what is stored...
customer.notice.unknown.now_deactivated: The answer did not arrive. When read again, the customer is deactivated. The request was sent once and is not repeated.
customer.notice.unknown.still_active: The answer did not arrive. When read again, the customer is still active, so the change is not stored. Press Deactivate to try again.
customer.notice.unknown.now_active: The answer did not arrive. When read again, the customer is active. The request was sent once and is not repeated.
customer.notice.unknown.still_deactivate: The answer did not arrive. When read again, the customer is still deactivated, so the change is not stored. Press Activate to try again.
customer.notice.unknown.not_locked: The answer did not arrive. When read again, the customer is not locked. The request was sent once and is not repeated.
customer.notice.unknown.still_locked: The answer did not arrive. When read again, the customer is still locked. Press Unlock to try again.
customer.notice.unknown.unreadable: The answer did not arrive and the customer could not be read again. Reload the page to see what is stored.
